scientific_question: Does loss of a high-leverage occupied source island predict greater subsequent contraction of other occupied island populations than loss of a low-leverage source, after nominal source count, ordinary distance, environment and external isolation are represented?

minimum_temporal_structure.t0: baseline occupancy used to define source islands and freeze source leverage
minimum_temporal_structure.t0_to_t1: exposure window in which occupied source losses are observed
minimum_temporal_structure.t1_to_t2: outcome window in which subsequent target-population persistence/loss is scored
minimum_temporal_structure.reason: source-loss exposure and target-population outcome must not be defined from the same transition window

analysis_population.species_requirement: focal species has at least two occupied source islands at t0 within the prospectively eligible island system
analysis_population.source_loss_event: an island occupied at t0 and unoccupied at t1
analysis_population.target_population: a different island occupied at t1 and eligible for t2 scoring
analysis_population.event_count_rule: nominal number of lost sources per focal species-event must be prospectively fixed before t2 access; preferred primary design is exactly one source loss so leverage is not confounded with loss count
analysis_population.same_species_multiple_events: must be clustered or otherwise dependency-adjusted under a rule frozen before t2 access

information_forbidden: t1 target outcomes other than source-loss identity
preloss_source_leverage.source_pressure_mass: sum over prospectively eligible target geometries of exp(-graph_distance(target,source)/lambda_region), with unreachable targets zero
preloss_source_leverage.source_share: source_pressure_mass divided by total pressure mass over occupied t0 sources
preloss_source_leverage.lost_source_leverage_primary_exposure: decrement in effective source number if the actually lost source is removed from the t0 occupied-source set
preloss_source_leverage.secondary_exposure: preloss source_share of the actually lost source
preloss_source_leverage.graph_semantics: paths traverse the full frozen island graph; occupied sources are endpoints and intermediate islands need not be occupied

R0: target occupancy history through t1 where prospectively legitimate
R2_add: number of source losses in the exposure window
C_add: or another leverage term frozen before confirmatory outcome access
reference_and_candidate.principle: the leverage candidate must earn heldout information beyond source count and ordinary source geometry

primary_endpoint.unit: target island population present at t1
primary_endpoint.outcome: persistence to t2 (1) versus loss by t2 (0), or the inverse coding if frozen prospectively
primary_endpoint.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and prospectively frozen cluster-bootstrap 95% upper confidence limit < 0

directional_secondary.prediction: greater lost-source leverage is associated with lower subsequent target persistence / greater subsequent contraction
directional_secondary.thresholding: continuous leverage preferred; any high/low threshold must be frozen before t2 access and cannot be chosen from the outcome

strongly_recommended: target occupancy history prior to t1
forbidden_rescue: dropping low-leverage events to strengthen direction
selecting taxa by observed leverage effect

validation_design.pilot_role: estimability and schema/quality checks only; no predictive effect estimate may enter manuscript evidence
validation_design.confirmatory_partition: must be disjoint by the prospectively declared validation unit
validation_design.preferred_validation_unit: archipelago, bioregion block, or species cluster chosen before t2 access
validation_design.source_features: all response-derived leverage/source features must be constructed without using the heldout confirmatory t2 outcome
validation_design.minimum_confirmatory_blocks: system-specific value must be frozen before pilot access; no universal number is imposed here

before_confirmatory_access_require: both persistence and loss outcomes are present in each estimable training complement under the frozen heldout design
enough source-loss events exist to identify the leverage contrast separately from loss count
lost-source leverage has nonzero variation after matching/reference adjustment
confirmatory units remain after response-quality attrition
estimability_gates.if_failed: STOP without confirmatory scoring; thresholds may not be relaxed after seeing pilot outcomes

mechanism_claim_boundary.if_supported_can_claim: preloss source leverage predicts future occupancy contraction beyond population count and ordinary source geometry in the tested system

relationship_to_current_structural_evide.v1_119_ultrarare_presence_result: hypothesis generation and occupancy-regime evidence only
